metadata.title: SpaceX surpasses Amazon and Microsoft to become the 4th largest company - MarketWatch

content.text:
17 hours ago
SpaceX surpasses Amazon and Microsoft to become the 4th largest company
SpaceX is continuing its strong momentum after its IPO last Friday. Elon Musk's space company gained 19.6% on the day of its public listing, another 14% yesterday, and is now up approximately 13%.
SpaceX traded as high as $225.64 today, which put the company's market cap just below the $3 trillion mark. That boost also pushed the company's valuation above both Amazon and Microsoft, making it the 4th-largest publicly traded company at one point. SpaceX shares have pulled back slightly since their session high, meaning Microsoft and SpaceX are neck-and-neck in competing for that No. 4 spot.
Investors were able to trade options contracts tied to SpaceX for the first time on Tuesday.
